# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 18 Nov 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Land Sales

- **October 2026 developer sales surge to 1,716 units** - New private home sales (excluding ECs) rebounded sharply in October 2026, rising 479.7% from September's 296 units, with Thomson Reserve and Lucerne Grand among the leading projects; this is the highest monthly volume since October 2025. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/october-2026-developer-sales/)

- **CapitaLand-led consortium submits S$1.82 billion top bid for Town Hall Link GLS white site** - The Jurong East tender closed with two bids, the highest from a consortium of CapitaLand Development, Sing Holdings, Far East Organization and Sino Group at approximately S$1.82 billion. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/jld-town-hall-link-gls-white-site/)

- **Hong Leong-TID JV awarded Orchard Boulevard GLS site at S$1,755 psf ppr** - URA awarded the Orchard Boulevard site to Intrepid Investments and TID Residential for S$181.86 million, translating to approximately S$1,755 per square foot per plot ratio. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/hong-leong-tid-jv-top-bids-orchard-boulevard-gls-site-at-s1755-psf-ppr/)

- **JLL expects Singapore construction costs to rise 2.5%–3.5% in 2026** - Rising costs may push developers toward asset enhancement and adaptive reuse of existing buildings rather than new construction, according to JLL. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/rising-construction-costs-set-force-developers/)

## HDB Resale & BTO

- **Record 238 HDB flats sold above S$1 million in October 2026** - The figure is nearly triple the 86 million-dollar HDB transactions recorded a year earlier, with Toa Payoh leading at 39 deals and Queenstown following with 31. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/238-hdb-flats-sold-s1m-october/)

- **Yishun records its first S$1.3 million HDB resale** - A 1,765 sq ft executive apartment at Yishun Avenue 4 sold for S$1,328,888 in November 2026, becoming the most expensive HDB resale across all flat types in the town and the first to cross the S$1.3 million mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/yishun-hdb-resale-record-nee-soon-central-view/)

## Niche & Investor Segments

- **Shophouse sales on track for a nine-year low in 2026** - Only 75 shophouse transactions have been recorded so far this year, with total value down 18% to S$675 million; a price standoff between buyers and sellers and scarce stock are cited as key factors, even as rents hold at S$6.50 psf per month. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/shophouse-sales-hit-9-year-low/)
